title: Emergency Follow-Up Visits on Single Specialist Referrals (Primary Care Provider Assignment)
content:
**Emergency utilization bulletin — Primary Care Provider Assignment, single specialist referrals.**

Emergency follow-up visits are added to a single specialist referral's visits, before the single-referral visit ceiling is applied. They are counted as the member's paid emergency-room claims for emergencies — claims in the emergency room (emergency) category booked on the member's **Medicaid Managed Care Membership** — with a service date in the emergency look-back window of **6 months**:

- **2 or more** such claims add the two-visit follow-up allowance (**2** visits);
- exactly **1** adds the one-visit follow-up allowance (**1** visit);
- none adds nothing.

The emergency look-back window is a trailing period counted back from the handling date in whole months: a claim is inside it when fewer than 6 whole months separate its service date from the handling date, so a claim dated exactly 6 months back is outside it. Claims in the emergency room (non-emergency) category are not emergency-room claims for emergencies.

| Paid emergency-room claims for emergencies in the last 6 months | Follow-up visits added |
|---|---|
| 0 | 0 |
| 1 | 1 |
| 2 | 2 |
| 4 | 2 |

**Hypothetical members, handling date 15 September 2026**

- Paid emergency claims on 16 March and 3 September 2026: both inside, 2 visits.
- Paid emergency claims on 15 March and 3 September 2026: the first is exactly 6 months back, outside; 1 visit.
